summary: Legacy VB6 banking application with critical security vulnerabilities, poor maintainability, and high modernization risk. Requires immediate security hardening and systematic refactoring.

hotspots.reason: Password change functionality without encryption, validation, or secure storage
Hardcoded database path with no connection pooling or error handling
No error handling in form navigation logic
Sensitive PII fields (nationalidno, email) without encryption indicators

risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: ADO/DAO data access without parameterized queries creates injection attack surface

risks.title: Plaintext Credential Storage
risks.description: No evidence of password hashing or encryption in authentication system

risks.title: PII Data Exposure
risks.description: Customer table contains sensitive data (nationalidno) without encryption

risks.title: Single Point of Failure
risks.description: Hardcoded database path creates deployment and disaster recovery risks

risks.title: Legacy Runtime Dependencies
risks.description: VB6 runtime and ActiveX controls create maintenance and security update challenges
